name: vn.fpt.campusstay.controller.application.ApplicationController
comment: Application wizard and the student's Application. Applications are addressed by their code ({@code APP-SP27-000123}, C-19); the Term is always the one open for registration.

methods.name: detail
methods.comment: Student: their own Application. Staff and Manager: the review view (the same path, C-21).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.controller.application.StudentController
comment: {@code /students/me/**} screens owned by Applications ({@code /students/**} is Student only).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.application.StudentApplicationQueries
comment: Student screens over Applications: Home, profile, My Applications, Application detail and the roommate invitation. A student only ever sees their own Applications; another student's code answers 404.

methods.name: focus
methods.comment: The Term of a live Application that has not ended, else the one open for registration, else current.

methods.name: events
methods.comment: What happened (done), then what comes next: the first upcoming step is current.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.application.StudentApplicationQueries$Home
comment: {@code allocation} and {@code checkedIn} are filled from S3/S4; {@code openRequests} from S4.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.application.StudentApplicationQueries$OfferRef
comment: The open Round-2 offer: answer it before {@code expiresAt} on the offer page.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.application.StudentApplicationQueries$Waitlist
comment: A waitlisted Application (A-61): the open offer, if any; {@code until} the day the waitlist ends (the Term's first check-in day); {@code refund} the Deposit paid, refunded in full when the student is not placed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assistant.StudentData
comment: The signed-in student's data the assistant answers from (ADR-28), read again for every question and put in the model's instructions. A small model does not reliably decide when to call tools, so it gets everything a student screen shows at once. Each section is read through the same service as its screen, so the student's scope and the services' own checks apply: the model never sees another student's records, door codes or anything the screens do not show. JSON without null fields; an empty list stays, so the model sees "none" rather than nothing; times in campus time and amounts written out in VND (a small model misreads raw numbers).

methods.name: clean
methods.comment: Drops hidden and null fields, writes amounts in VND and UTC instants in campus time (the model does not convert).
